use_when.statement: Use progress to show how far along a measurable thing is — a score against a target, an initiative’s completion, a multi-step flow.
use_when.verbatim: Use progress to show how far along a measurable thing is — a score against a target, an initiative’s completion, a multi-step flow.

dont_use_when.verbatim: Don’t use it for an unknown wait; use Spinner instead.

placement.statement: in a card body beneath a metric, and in a kanban card

a11y.fact: role="progressbar" sits on the track, not the wrapper: a progressbar’s contents are not exposed to assistive tech, so putting it on the wrapper would swallow the label and the value text
carries aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax, with the percent clamped to 0-100
named by reference via aria-labelledby when a label is shown, and by aria-label when it is not, so the bar is never unnamed
